name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 84 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A pre-packaged bundle of skills that turns an AI coding assistant into a senior bug-bounty hunter and red-team researcher, complete with attack playbooks for real companies' systems.
buyer: A boutique penetration-testing or bug-bounty consultancy that wants its junior researchers to work faster without hiring a senior red-teamer.
business_use_cases: A bug-bounty hunter runs it against an authorized target to triage easy vulnerability classes first, saving their own time for the hard findings.
A pentest firm uses the enterprise identity/infrastructure attack matrices to standardize how junior staff approach M365, Okta, and VPN-appliance engagements.
A security trainer builds a paid bootcamp around the bundle, teaching students via its disclosed-report pattern library.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'pro' tier with proprietary attack-chain templates and private CVE research not in the free bundle.
Offer paid engagement-review services where the author audits a firm's findings for completeness.

steal_this: Package one of the 24 vulnerability-class skill modules as a standalone, well-documented Claude Code skill and sell it on skills.sh this weekend.
